name: Shoals grain-boat confrontation
description: d0/dawn beside Bera's second grain boat. Halla says 'Make me' and takes an en-garde stance with held handaxe. Battleaxe remains secured. Corporal releases mooring rope and reaches to draw sheathed sword; escort shield on arm and sword sheathed. Rusk shield raised, sword sheathed. Tied mooring, full HP, no attack yet, no surprise bonus: Halla's spoken threat already alerted both soldiers.
summary: Resolved without injury. Halla stepped back and ordered both Dragon Knights away. Intimidation Easy81/84 beat corporal Willpower39/50; the escort recovered her sword and both withdrew. Bera's boats, cargo and crews remained secure. Halla Luck2.
